title: Lean Klein-Gordon Derivation
description: Lean 4 formalization of a seven-stage, scoped Klein-Gordon continuum readout from the LFM c40 two-field C19 action and centered update. The release derives the selected linearized lattice mode, its exact discrete dispersion, the isotropic C19 coefficient, explicit spatial and temporal error bounds, and a normalized long-wave spectral readout whose finite continuum mode sums solve (partial_t^2 - 12 Laplacian + 361) phi = 0. The normalization subtracts the onsite rest contribution, rescales the long-wave frequency shift by the squared lattice spacing, and restores the rest contribution. The release does not prove convergence of arbitrary nonlinear native trajectories, a native propagating massless branch, a physical particle, or that LFM models nature.
